subject: Future plans for Shiny Server / Enterprise

messages.author: 30c328c0cb741d16
messages.subject: Future plans for Shiny Server / Enterprise
parts: I would like to ask for information about future releases of Shiny Server. I remember reading something about a "Shiny Server enterprise edition" but the release date which was given in that past blog entry already passed. Are there any plans / time schedules that can be given. I am planning to publish a Shiny based web application later that year and would be interested if there is a schedule for Shiny Server to leave beta status (since I guess that will be the date when it is available as enterprise edition?).

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: Future plans for Shiny Server / Enterprise
parts:
Hi Robert. Please contact Tareef Kawaf (tar...@rstudio.com) for more info on the "Shiny Server Pro" release plans. We're hoping to get something out as quickly as we (reliably) can!

Thanks,
Jeff
